newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Bank Austria says 96 net drop exaggerated.
newsitem.headline: Bank Austria says 96 net drop exaggerated.

text.p: Bank Austria said on Thursday a 39 percent drop in 1996 group operating profit, announced last week, was exaggerated by one-off revenues reported by the parent company the previous year.
Finance director Franz Zwickl said a 200 million schillings decline in leasing profit and a 100 million schilling fall in subsidiary contributions had also weighed on the group result.
Bank Austria's 1996 group net profit fell to 1.587 billion schillings from 2.587 billion. Parent net was 1.709 billion schillings after 2.168 billion.

"The parent net profit in 1995 was buoyed by one off revenues (from the sale of real estate). If one compares 1996 net profit with 1994, then we see an increase of 49.8 percent," Bank Austria said in a statement. -- Vienna newsroom, +43-1 531 12 254
